children: India's fiscal deficit (INFISC=ECI) in the months of April-July stood at 4.55 trillion rupees ($47.81 billion), or 26.8% of the target for the financial year ending March 31, government data showed on Monday.
The deficit in the same period last year stood at 4.7 trillion rupees.
